name: Feishu
description: Connect Feishu workspaces and handle collaboration or business data within explicit permission and confirmation boundaries.
authorization.title: Authorize a Feishu account
authorization.description: Sign in with the Feishu application configured by your organization. OAuth access and Feishu app permissions are separate; an administrator must grant missing business permissions in the Feishu Open Platform.
capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.office.title: Workplace collaboration
capabilities.office.description: Work with calendars, tasks, documents, drive, mail, meetings, chat, and contacts.
capabilities.collaboration.title: Business applications
capabilities.collaboration.description: Work with Base, spreadsheets, approvals, attendance, OKR, Miaoda apps, and other Feishu business data.
capabilities.safety.title: Action confirmation
capabilities.safety.description: Read and ordinary write operations follow the Feishu command catalog; high-risk writes show exact arguments and require one-time confirmation.
configuration.appId.label: App ID
configuration.appId.description: The App ID of your Feishu Open Platform application.
configuration.appSecret.label: App Secret
configuration.appSecret.description: The App Secret of your Feishu Open Platform application.
